question: Combine 2-script with full, keep separate, fix condensed manageability, or work speed on full?

OPT_COMBINE.label: Combine 2-script condensed with full integrations into one hybrid deliverable
OPT_COMBINE.maintainability: weak unless combine means full tree + generated artifacts only

OPT_SEPARATE.label: Keep 2-script and full strictly separate
OPT_SEPARATE.maintainability: good if full is source of truth and condensed is rebuilt

OPT_FIX_CONDENSED_A.label: Start from Fix A: full remains editable; condensed is build-only artifact

OPT_FIX_CONDENSED_B.label: Start from Fix B: reorganize into editable spine package + optional export

OPT_SPEED_FULL.label: Prioritize speed and other product work on full package only
OPT_SPEED_FULL.maintainability: good for full; condensed debt remains if still primary

rationale: Full integrations is the maintainable source of truth (product, CI, schemas, pipeline).
Condensed 2-script is a distribution form — must not be the edit surface (Fix A).
Keeping them separate in role avoids confusing 'which file do I change?'
Combining is OK only as: one zip = full tree + generated condensed artifacts (not hand-merged code).
Speed work belongs on full (where adversarial was ~2x slower); gains then flow into regenerated condensed.
Fix B is valid later for packaging polish; not required to unblock maintainability.
order_of_work: 1. Declare full package canonical; condensed = build output only (Fix A policy)
2. Keep deliverables separate in role (or one zip with both, generated spine clearly marked GENERATED)
4. Optional later: Fix B spine package layout
